column1: Hydrogenium|The lightest element occurs in water and organic molecules. Used for ammonia production and fuel cells.|Elementum levissimum in aqua et moleculis organicis invenitur. Ad ammoniacum fabricandum et in cellulis combustibilibus adhibetur.

Helium|A noble gas with an exceptionally low boiling point. Used for cooling superconducting magnets and protective atmospheres.|Gas nobilis temperaturam ebullitionis minimam habet. Ad magnetes superconductivos refrigerandos et atmosphaeras protegentes adhibetur.

Lithium|A light alkali metal that readily loses an electron. Used in rechargeable batteries, special glass and alloys.|Metallum alcalinum leve electronem facile amittit. In accumulatris electricis, vitro speciali et mixturis metallicis adhibetur.

Beryllium|A light, stiff metal whose dust is hazardous to inhale. Used in special alloys, optics and X-ray windows.|Metallum leve rigidumque est, cuius pulvis inhalatus nocet. In mixturis specialibus, instrumentis opticis et fenestris radiorum X adhibetur.

Borum|A metalloid that forms hard materials and oxygen compounds. Used in borosilicate glass, detergents and semiconductors.|Semimetallum materias duras et composita cum oxygenio format. In vitro borosilicatico, detergentibus et semiconductoribus adhibetur.

Carboneum|The foundation of organic chemistry forms diamond, graphite and graphene. Used in steel, carbon fibres, electrodes and organic materials.|Fundamentum chemiae organicae adamantem, graphiten et graphenum format. In chalybe, fibris carbonicis, electrodis et materiis organicis adhibetur.

Nitrogenium|The main component of air is also part of proteins and nucleic acids. Used in fertilisers, protective atmospheres and cryogenic cooling.|Pars maxima aeris etiam in proteinis et acidis nucleicis invenitur. In stercoribus, atmosphaeris protegentibus et refrigeratione cryogenica adhibetur.

Oxygenium|A constituent of water and oxides is essential for aerobic respiration. Used in metallurgy, oxidation and technical and medical gases.|Pars aquae et oxidorum ad respirationem aerobicam necessaria est. In metallurgia, oxidatione et gasibus technicis atque medicinalibus adhibetur.

Fluorum|A highly reactive halogen differs greatly from its fluoride compounds. Used in fluoropolymers, fluorides and special chemicals.|Halogenum valde reactivum a compositis fluoridis multum differt. In fluoropolymeris, fluoridis et substantiis specialibus adhibetur.

Neon|A noble gas produces a characteristic red-orange electrical discharge. Used in luminous tubes and indicator lamps.|Gas nobilis emissionem electricam rubro-aurantiam producit. In tubis luminosis et lampadibus indicantibus adhibetur.

Natrium|A reactive alkali metal forms ions found in body fluids. Used in chemical production, sodium lamps and heat-transfer media.|Metallum alcalinum reactivum iones in humoribus corporis praebet. In industria chemica, lampadibus natrii et mediis caloriferis adhibetur.

Magnesium|A light metal forms the central atom of chlorophyll. Used in lightweight alloys, metallurgy and pyrotechnics.|Metallum leve atomum centralem chlorophylli constituit. In mixturis levibus, metallurgia et pyrotechnia adhibetur.

Aluminium|A light metal is protected by a thin surface oxide layer. Used in structures, packaging, conductors and transport.|Metallum leve tenui oxidi strato protegitur. In structuris, involucris, conductoribus et vehiculis adhibetur.

Silicium|A metalloid has compounds that form much of the Earth's crust. Used in microchips, solar cells, glass and silicones.|Semimetallum composita format quae magnam crustae terrestris partem constituunt. In circuitibus integratis, cellulis solaribus, vitro et siliconibus adhibetur.

Phosphorus|A constituent of DNA, ATP and bone phosphates. Used in fertilisers and phosphate compounds.|Pars acidi desoxyribonucleici, ATP et phosphatum ossium est. In stercoribus et compositis phosphoricis adhibetur.

Sulfur|A nonmetal occurs in some amino acids and minerals. Used in sulfuric acid production and rubber vulcanisation.|Nonmetallum in quibusdam aminoacidis et mineralibus invenitur. Ad acidum sulfuricum fabricandum et gummi vulcanizandum adhibetur.

Chlorum|A reactive halogen forms chloride ions in table salt. Used in water treatment, PVC and chemical synthesis.|Halogenum reactivum iones chloridi in sale culinari format. In purificatione aquae, PVC et synthesi chemica adhibetur.

Argon|A low-reactivity noble gas is obtained from air. Used in welding, protective atmospheres and insulating glass.|Gas nobilis parum reactivus ex aere separatur. In ferruminatione, atmosphaeris protegentibus et vitro insulante adhibetur.

Kalium|An alkali metal has ions important to nerve and muscle cells. Used in potassium fertilisers and industrial compounds.|Metallum alcalinum iones cellulis nervorum et musculorum necessarios praebet. In stercoribus potassicis et compositis industrialibus adhibetur.

Calcium|A constituent of limestone and bone mineral also acts as a cellular signal. Used in cement, lime, metallurgy and calcium compounds.|Pars lapidis calcarii et mineralis ossium etiam signum cellulare praebet. In caemento, calce, metallurgia et compositis calcicis adhibetur.

Scandium|A light transition metal occurs dispersed in minerals. Used in special aluminium alloys and discharge lamps.|Metallum transitionis leve in mineralibus dispersum invenitur. In mixturis aluminii specialibus et lampadibus adhibetur.

Titanium|A strong, light, corrosion-resistant metal. Used in aerospace alloys, implants and titanium dioxide pigments.|Metallum firmum leveque corrosioni resistit. In mixturis aeronauticis, implantatis et pigmentis dioxidi titanii adhibetur.

Vanadium|A transition metal forms several oxidation states. Used in steel alloys, catalysts and flow batteries.|Metallum transitionis varios status oxidationis format. In chalybe, catalysatoribus et accumulatris fluentibus adhibetur.

Chromium|A metal gives hardness and corrosion resistance to alloys. Used in stainless steel, coatings and pigments.|Metallum duritiem et resistentiam contra corrosionem mixturis praebet. In chalybe inoxidabili, tegumentis et pigmentis adhibetur.

Manganum|A transition metal is also a trace element in enzymes. Used in steelmaking, batteries and oxidising agents.|Metallum transitionis etiam elementum vestigiale enzymorum est. In fabricatione chalybis, pilis electricis et oxidantibus adhibetur.

Ferrum|The basic metal of steel is also essential to haemoglobin. Used in structural steel, machines, tools and magnetic materials.|Metallum principale chalybis etiam in haemoglobino necessarium est. In structuris, machinis, instrumentis et materiis magneticis adhibetur.

Cobaltum|A transition metal also occurs in vitamin B₁₂. Used in battery cathodes, superalloys and blue pigments.|Metallum transitionis etiam in vitamino B₁₂ invenitur. In cathodis accumulatorum, supermixturis et pigmentis caeruleis adhibetur.

Niccolum|A corrosion-resistant transition metal. Used in stainless steel, batteries, alloys and catalysts.|Metallum transitionis corrosioni resistit. In chalybe inoxidabili, accumulatris, mixturis et catalysatoribus adhibetur.

Cuprum|A metal has high electrical and thermal conductivity. Used in wiring, electronics, pipes and alloys.|Metallum electricitatem et calorem bene conducit. In filis electricis, electronicis, fistulis et mixturis adhibetur.

Zincum|A metal is also a constituent of many biological enzymes. Used to protect steel from corrosion and in brass and batteries.|Metallum etiam pars multorum enzymorum est. Ad chalybem contra corrosionem protegendum et in orichalco atque pilis electricis adhibetur.

Gallium|A metal melts near room temperature. Used in GaAs and GaN semiconductors, LEDs and high-frequency electronics.|Metallum prope temperaturam ambientem liquescit. In semiconductoribus GaAs et GaN, diodis luminosis et electronicis adhibetur.

Germanium|A metalloid is used in optical and semiconductor materials. Used in infrared optics, optical fibres and electronics.|Semimetallum in materiis opticis et semiconductoribus adhibetur. Instrumentis infrarubris, fibris opticis et electronicis inservit.

Arsenicum|A metalloid has many toxic compounds. Used in specialised semiconductors and materials research.|Semimetallum multa composita venenosa format. In semiconductoribus specialibus et investigatione materiarum adhibetur.

Selenium|A nonmetal is a trace element in selenoproteins. Used in glass, photoconductive materials and chemical production.|Nonmetallum elementum vestigiale selenoproteinorum est. In vitro, materiis photoconductivis et industria chemica adhibetur.

Bromum|A halogen is liquid at ordinary room temperature. Used in brominated chemicals and specialised industrial processes.|Halogenum ad temperaturam ambientem liquidum est. In compositis bromatis et processibus industrialibus specialibus adhibetur.

Krypton|A noble gas has applications in electrical discharges. Used in lamps, lasers and insulating glass.|Gas nobilis in emissionibus electricis utilis est. In lampadibus, laseribus et vitro insulante adhibetur.

Rubidium|A highly reactive alkali metal. Used in atomic clocks and research on ultracold atoms.|Metallum alcalinum valde reactivum est. In horologiis atomicis et investigatione atomorum frigidissimorum adhibetur.

Strontium|An alkaline earth metal is chemically similar to calcium. Used in red pyrotechnics, magnets and special glass.|Metallum alcalino-terrosum calcii simile est. In pyrotechnia rubra, magnetibus et vitro speciali adhibetur.

Yttrium|A metal is used in advanced ceramic and optical materials. Used in phosphors, lasers and technical ceramics.|Metallum in materiis ceramicis et opticis provectis adhibetur. Luminophoris, laseribus et ceramicis technicis inservit.

Zirconium|A corrosion-resistant metal differs from zirconium oxide. Used in nuclear technology, ceramics and chemical equipment.|Metallum corrosioni resistens ab oxido zirconii differt. In technologia nucleari, ceramicis et apparatibus chemicis adhibetur.

Niobium|A refractory metal forms strong and superconducting alloys. Used in microalloyed steel and superconducting magnets.|Metallum refractarium mixturas firmas et superconductivas format. In chalybe microlegato et magnetibus superconductivis adhibetur.

Molybdaenum|A metal has a high melting point. Used in heat-resistant alloys, steel and catalysts.|Metallum altam temperaturam fusionis habet. In mixturis caloris resistentibus, chalybe et catalysatoribus adhibetur.
Technetium|An element has no stable isotopes. Technetium-99m is used in diagnostic nuclear medicine.|Elementum isotopis stabilibus caret. Technetium-99m in diagnostica medicinae nuclearis adhibetur.

Ruthenium|A platinum-group metal has catalytic properties. Used in catalysts, electrical contacts and special coatings.|Metallum gregis platini proprietates catalyticas habet. In catalysatoribus, contactibus electricis et tegumentis specialibus adhibetur.

Rhodium|A rare platinum-group metal. Used in automotive catalysts and durable reflective coatings.|Metallum rarum gregis platini est. In catalysatoribus vehiculorum et tegumentis reflectentibus adhibetur.

Palladium|A platinum-group metal can absorb hydrogen. Used in catalysts, electronics and hydrogen materials research.|Metallum gregis platini hydrogenium absorbere potest. In catalysatoribus, electronicis et investigatione materiarum hydrogenii adhibetur.

Argentum|A metal has exceptionally high electrical conductivity. Used in electrical contacts, jewellery, optical coatings and solar cells.|Metallum electricitatem optime conducit. In contactibus electricis, ornamentis, tegumentis opticis et cellulis solaribus adhibetur.

Cadmium|A toxic metal has restricted industrial applications. Used in some batteries, semiconductors and specialised coatings.|Metallum venenosum usus industriales restrictos habet. In quibusdam accumulatris, semiconductoribus et tegumentis specialibus adhibetur.

Indium|A soft metal is used in electronic materials. Used in transparent ITO conductors, displays and solders.|Metallum molle in materiis electronicis adhibetur. Conductoribus ITO pellucidis, ostentatoribus et mixturis ferruminantibus inservit.

Stannum|A metal is common in solders and protective coatings. Used in soldering, tin-coated packaging and bronze.|Metallum in mixturis ferruminantibus et tegumentis protegentibus frequens est. In ferruminatione, involucris stannatis et aere adhibetur.

Stibium|A metalloid changes the properties of alloys and compounds. Used in flame retardants, alloys and semiconductors.|Semimetallum proprietates mixturarum et compositorum mutat. In retardantibus flammae, mixturis et semiconductoribus adhibetur.

Tellurium|A metalloid is used in specialised semiconductors. Used in CdTe solar cells and thermoelectric materials.|Semimetallum in semiconductoribus specialibus adhibetur. Cellulis solaribus CdTe et materiis thermoelectricis inservit.

Iodum|A halogen is required for thyroid hormones. Used in iodides, contrast compounds and chemical synthesis.|Halogenum ad hormonas glandulae thyroideae necessarium est. In iodidis, compositis contrastantibus et synthesi chemica adhibetur.

Xenon|A heavy noble gas can form some compounds. Used in lamps, ion engines and specialised imaging.|Gas nobilis gravis quaedam composita formare potest. In lampadibus, motoribus ionicis et imaginibus technicis adhibetur.

Caesium|A highly reactive alkali metal. Used in caesium atomic clocks and atomic physics research.|Metallum alcalinum valde reactivum est. In horologiis atomicis caesii et investigatione physicae atomicae adhibetur.

Barium|An alkaline earth metal has compounds with very different properties. Used in drilling fluids containing barite, glass and ceramics.|Metallum alcalino-terrosum composita proprietatibus diversis format. In fluidis terebrantibus cum baryta, vitro et ceramicis adhibetur.

Lanthanum|A member of the lanthanoid series. Used in optical glass, catalysts and battery alloys.|Elementum seriei lanthanoidorum est. In vitro optico, catalysatoribus et mixturis accumulatorum adhibetur.

Cerium|A lanthanoid readily changes its oxidation state. Used in glass polishing, catalysts and ignition alloys.|Lanthanoidum statum oxidationis facile mutat. Ad vitrum poliendum et in catalysatoribus atque mixturis ignitionis adhibetur.

Praseodymium|A lanthanoid is used in magnetic and optical materials. Used in permanent magnets, alloys and coloured glass.|Lanthanoidum in materiis magneticis et opticis adhibetur. Magnetibus permanentibus, mixturis et vitro colorato inservit.

Neodymium|A lanthanoid is important for powerful permanent magnets. Used in NdFeB magnets, electric motors and lasers.|Lanthanoidum ad magnetes permanentes fortes pertinet. In magnetibus NdFeB, motoribus electricis et laseribus adhibetur.

Promethium|A lanthanoid has no stable isotopes. Used in research and specialised radioisotope sources.|Lanthanoidum isotopis stabilibus caret. In investigatione et fontibus radioisotoporum specialibus adhibetur.

Samarium|A lanthanoid gives magnetic properties to alloys. Used in samarium-cobalt magnets and nuclear technology.|Lanthanoidum mixturis proprietates magneticas praebet. In magnetibus samarii et cobalti atque technologia nucleari adhibetur.

Europium|A lanthanoid is known for luminescent compounds. Used in red and blue phosphors and optical materials.|Lanthanoidum composita luminescentia format. In luminophoris rubris et caeruleis atque materiis opticis adhibetur.

Gadolinium|A lanthanoid has strong magnetic properties. Used in magnetic materials and complex compounds for imaging.|Lanthanoidum proprietates magneticas fortes habet. In materiis magneticis et compositis complexis ad imagines formandas adhibetur.

Terbium|A lanthanoid is used in optical and magnetic materials. Used in green phosphors, magnetic alloys and sensors.|Lanthanoidum in materiis opticis et magneticis adhibetur. Luminophoris viridibus, mixturis magneticis et sensoribus inservit.

Dysprosium|A lanthanoid helps magnets retain their properties at higher temperatures. Used in powerful magnets and specialised alloys.|Lanthanoidum magnetes proprietates ad temperaturas altas conservare adiuvat. In magnetibus fortibus et mixturis specialibus adhibetur.
Holmium|A lanthanoid has notable magnetic properties. Used in lasers and magnetic research.|Lanthanoidum proprietates magneticas insignes habet. In laseribus et investigatione magnetica adhibetur.

Erbium|A lanthanoid has important infrared optical transitions. Used in optical-fibre amplifiers and lasers.|Lanthanoidum transitiones opticas infrarubras praebet. In amplificatoribus fibrarum opticarum et laseribus adhibetur.

Thulium|A rare lanthanoid is used in optical technology. Used in lasers and specialised radiation sources.|Lanthanoidum rarum in technologia optica adhibetur. Laseribus et fontibus radiationis specialibus inservit.

Ytterbium|A lanthanoid is studied in quantum and optical physics. Used in fibre lasers and precise atomic measurements.|Lanthanoidum in physica quantica et optica investigatur. In laseribus fibrarum et mensuris atomicis accuratis adhibetur.

Lutetium|The last member of the lanthanoid series. Used in scintillators, catalysts and radioisotope technology.|Ultimum elementum seriei lanthanoidorum est. In scintillatoribus, catalysatoribus et technologia radioisotoporum adhibetur.

Hafnium|A refractory metal is chemically similar to zirconium. Used in nuclear technology, superalloys and microelectronic dielectrics.|Metallum refractarium zirconii simile est. In technologia nucleari, supermixturis et dielectricis microelectronicis adhibetur.

Tantalum|A corrosion-resistant metal forms a stable oxide layer. Used in capacitors, chemical equipment and implants.|Metallum corrosioni resistens stratum oxidi stabile format. In condensatoribus, apparatibus chemicis et implantatis adhibetur.

Wolframium|A metal has an exceptionally high melting point. Used in carbide tools, electrodes and high-temperature applications.|Metallum temperaturam fusionis altissimam habet. In instrumentis carbureti, electrodis et operibus temperaturae altae adhibetur.
Rhenium|A rare refractory metal. Used in turbine superalloys and catalysts.|Metallum rarum refractarium est. In supermixturis turbinarum et catalysatoribus adhibetur.
Osmium|A dense platinum-group metal. Used in specialised alloys and research compounds.|Metallum densum gregis platini est. In mixturis specialibus et compositis investigandis adhibetur.

Iridium|A platinum-group metal strongly resists corrosion. Used in electrodes, spark plugs and durable components.|Metallum gregis platini corrosioni valde resistit. In electrodis, candelis ignitionis et partibus durabilibus adhibetur.

Platinum|A precious metal has important catalytic properties. Used in catalysts, electrodes and jewellery.|Metallum pretiosum proprietates catalyticas insignes habet. In catalysatoribus, electrodis et ornamentis adhibetur.

Aurum|A precious metal resists oxidation. Used in electronic contacts, jewellery and specialised materials.|Metallum pretiosum oxidationi resistit. In contactibus electronicis, ornamentis et materiis specialibus adhibetur.

Hydrargyrum|A metal is liquid at room temperature. Used in specialised lamps and instruments, while many older uses are restricted.|Metallum ad temperaturam ambientem liquidum est. In lampadibus et instrumentis specialibus adhibetur, dum multi usus veteres restringuntur.
Thallium|A soft and highly toxic metal. Used in specialised detectors and electronic materials.|Metallum molle et valde venenosum est. In detectoribus specialibus et materiis electronicis adhibetur.

Plumbum|A dense, soft and toxic metal. Used in lead-acid batteries and radiation shielding.|Metallum densum, molle et venenosum est. In accumulatris plumbi et protectione contra radiationem ionizantem adhibetur.

Bismuthum|A brittle metal is used in low-melting alloys. Used in fusible alloys and bismuth compounds.|Metallum fragile in mixturis facile fusilibus invenitur. In mixturis fusilibus et compositis bismuthi adhibetur.

Polonium|A strongly radioactive element has no stable isotopes. Used in specialised research on radioactivity and alpha-particle sources.|Elementum valde radioactivum isotopis stabilibus caret. In investigatione radioactivitatis et fontium particularum alpha adhibetur.

Astatinum|A very rare radioactive halogen. Used in radionuclide research and studies of possible applications.|Halogenum radioactivum rarissimum est. In investigatione radionuclidorum et usuum possibilium adhibetur.

Radon|A radioactive noble gas is produced in decay chains. Studied in radioactivity research and natural background measurements.|Gas nobilis radioactivus in seriebus disintegrationis oritur. In investigatione radioactivitatis et mensuris radiationis naturalis studetur.

Francium|An extremely rare radioactive alkali metal. Used in fundamental atomic physics research.|Metallum alcalinum radioactivum rarissimum est. In investigatione fundamentali physicae atomicae adhibetur.

Radium|A radioactive alkaline earth metal. Used in radiochemical research and specialised isotope applications.|Metallum alcalino-terrosum radioactivum est. In investigatione radiochemica et usibus isotopicis specialibus adhibetur.

Actinium|A radioactive element begins the actinoid series. Used in radioisotope and actinoid chemistry research.|Elementum radioactivum seriem actinoidorum incipit. In investigatione radioisotoporum et chemiae actinoidorum adhibetur.

Thorium|A naturally occurring radioactive actinoid. Studied for nuclear fuel cycles and materials.|Actinoidum radioactivum in natura invenitur. Ad cyclos combustibilium nuclearium et materias investigandas studetur.
Protactinium|A rare radioactive actinoid. Used in radiochemical and geochemical research.|Actinoidum radioactivum rarum est. In investigatione radiochemica et geochemica adhibetur.

Uranium|A heavy radioactive metal has naturally occurring isotopes. Used in nuclear fuel, geochronology and actinoid research.|Metallum grave radioactivum isotopos naturales habet. In combustibili nucleari, geochronologia et investigatione actinoidorum adhibetur.

Neptunium|A radioactive transuranium element. Used in research on nuclear chemistry and isotope transformations.|Elementum transuranicum radioactivum est. In investigatione chemiae nuclearis et transformationum isotopicarum adhibetur.

Plutonium|A radioactive transuranium metal. Used in nuclear technology and radioisotope power sources.|Metallum transuranicum radioactivum est. In technologia nucleari et fontibus energiae radioisotopicis adhibetur.

Americium|An artificially produced radioactive actinoid. Used in some ionisation smoke detectors and research sources.|Actinoidum radioactivum artificiose paratur. In quibusdam detectoribus fumi ionizantibus et fontibus investigationis adhibetur.

Curium|A radioactive actinoid is named after Marie and Pierre Curie. Used in scientific radiation sources and heavy-element research.|Actinoidum radioactivum a Maria et Petro Curie nomen accepit. In fontibus radiationis et investigatione elementorum gravium adhibetur.

Berkelium|A synthetic radioactive actinoid. Used to study transuranium elements and synthesise heavier nuclei.|Actinoidum radioactivum syntheticum est. Ad elementa transuranica investiganda et nucleos graviores creandos adhibetur.

Californium|A synthetic actinoid has isotopes that emit neutrons. Used in neutron sources and nuclear physics research.|Actinoidum syntheticum isotopos neutrones emittentes habet. In fontibus neutronum et investigatione physicae nuclearis adhibetur.

Einsteinium|A synthetic radioactive actinoid is available only in small quantities. Used in fundamental heavy-element research.|Actinoidum syntheticum radioactivum tantum parvis quantitatibus paratur. In investigatione fundamentali elementorum gravium adhibetur.

Fermium|A synthetic radioactive actinoid. Used in research on nuclear properties and actinoid chemistry.|Actinoidum syntheticum radioactivum est. In investigatione proprietatum nuclearum et chemiae actinoidorum adhibetur.

Mendelevium|A synthetic actinoid is prepared atom by atom or in tiny amounts. Used exclusively in research on heavy elements.|Actinoidum syntheticum singulis atomis vel quantitatibus minimis paratur. Tantum in investigatione elementorum gravium adhibetur.

Nobelium|A synthetic radioactive actinoid. Used to study actinoid chemistry and nuclear structure.|Actinoidum syntheticum radioactivum est. Ad chemiam actinoidorum et structuram nucleorum investigandas adhibetur.

Lawrencium|A synthetic radioactive element ends the actinoid series. Used to study electronic structure and heavy nuclei.|Elementum syntheticum radioactivum seriem actinoidorum terminat. Ad structuram electronicam et nucleos graves investigandos adhibetur.

Rutherfordium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 4. Used to investigate the chemistry of superheavy elements.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi quarto pertinet. Ad chemiam elementorum supergravium investigandam adhibetur.

Dubnium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 5. Used to study nuclear stability and single-atom chemistry.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi quinto pertinet. Ad stabilitatem nucleorum et chemiam atomorum singulorum investigandas adhibetur.

Seaborgium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 6. Used to investigate superheavy-atom chemistry.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi sexto pertinet. Ad chemiam atomorum supergravium investigandam adhibetur.

Bohrium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 7. Used in fundamental nuclear physics and chemistry research.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi septimo pertinet. In investigatione fundamentali physicae et chemiae nuclearis adhibetur.

Hassium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 8. Used to study the chemistry of very heavy atoms.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi octavo pertinet. Ad chemiam atomorum gravissimorum investigandam adhibetur.

Meitnerium|A synthetic superheavy element has short-lived isotopes. Used to study the formation and decay of superheavy nuclei.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave isotopos brevis vitae habet. Ad formationem et disintegrationem nucleorum supergravium investigandas adhibetur.

Darmstadtium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 10. Used to study heavy-nucleus stability and decay chains.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi decimo pertinet. Ad stabilitatem nucleorum gravium et series disintegrationis investigandas adhibetur.

Roentgenium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 11. Used in research on superheavy nuclear physics.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi undecimo pertinet. In investigatione physicae nucleorum supergravium adhibetur.

Copernicium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 12. Used to study relativistic effects in heavy atoms.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi duodecimo pertinet. Ad effectus relativisticos in atomis gravibus investigandos adhibetur.

Nihonium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 13. Used to study the production and properties of superheavy elements.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi tertio decimo pertinet. Ad formationem et proprietates elementorum supergravium investigandas adhibetur.

Flerovium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 14. Used to study nuclear stability and single-atom chemistry.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi quarto decimo pertinet. Ad stabilitatem nuclearum et chemiam atomorum singulorum investigandas adhibetur.

Moscovium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 15. Used to study the formation and decay of superheavy nuclei.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi quinto decimo pertinet. Ad formationem et disintegrationem nucleorum supergravium investigandas adhibetur.

Livermorium|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 16. Used in fundamental nuclear physics research.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi sexto decimo pertinet. In investigatione fundamentali physicae nuclearis adhibetur.

Tennessine|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 17. Used in nuclear research, with no ordinary chemical applications.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi septimo decimo pertinet. In investigatione nucleari adhibetur, sine usu chemico ordinario.

Oganesson|A synthetic superheavy element belongs to group 18. Studied in nuclear research, with properties unlike ordinary noble gases.|Elementum syntheticum supergrave gregi duodevicesimo pertinet. In investigatione nucleari studetur et a gasibus nobilibus ordinariis proprietatibus differt.
